lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in a staggered grid-like formation starting posterior to the gill slits, following the longitudinal axis of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features run horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a pronounced light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region and visible pectoral fin exhibit a high density of significantly smaller, high-luminance pixel clusters compared to the lateral flank.
